Title: Did I miss a meeting with the card text migrations?

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
Around the time Sabbat War was printed, Elysium: the Arboretum
was errated to end combat only between opposing Camarilla vampires,
instead of any two vampires. For some reason, this is listed as a
"Card text migration" - even though there was no new copy of
E:tA printed in Sabbat War.

This should be errata, I think. It was my understanding that
there needed to be an actual new, reprinted card to call it a
"Card text migration", no?

Fred

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No errata needed - that's a rule from the rulebook. [10.1]
But you're right - it's not a card text migration, it's a rulebook
migration.

--

yerg. This should be listed differently in "Card Text Migrations"
somehow so people like me don't bang their head (on their desk,
deliberately, when they hear the answer). I'm sure I heard this
before back when it happened. Next year or the year after, I'll
probably notice the same thing and be confused again.

It would be nice if the "SW" next to the third entry for Elysium,
The Arboretum hand an asterisk or something alerting people to the
fact that this was due to a change in the game rules, not a new
card.

Fred (maybe here's my card that's like smoking pot - I'm thinking,
